user_story: As a user, I want to receive a notification message after clicking a link so that I can be informed of the action's result. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When the user navigates to the page at 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/notification_message_rendered', they should see the heading 'Notification Message'. 2. Upon clicking the link 'Click here', a notification message should be displayed in the 'div' with id 'flash-messages'.
cypress_script: describe('Notification Messages', () => { it('should display a notification message when clicking the link', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/notification_message_rendered'); cy.get('a').contains('Click here').click(); cy.get('#flash-messages').should('contain', 'You successfully clicked an alert'); }); it('should not display a notification message when the page is loaded', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/notification_message_rendered'); cy.get('#flash-messages').should('not.exist'); }); });
playwright_script: import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('Notification Messages', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/notification_message_rendered'); await page.click('text=Click here'); const flashMessages = await page.locator('#flash-messages'); await expect(flashMessages).toContainText('You successfully clicked an alert'); }); test('should not display a notification message when the page is loaded', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/notification_message_rendered'); const flashMessages = await page.locator('#flash-messages'); await expect(flashMessages).toHaveCount(0); }); }
